analysis.summary: The measured issue is absent gross-positive opportunities at the tested size: all 2,148 quote outputs are below the 0.001 WETH input, and the packet reports zero positive-gross quotes. Lowering the edge threshold cannot turn those negative gross edges positive, so this history does not support a useful bounded economic-policy test.

findings.observation: At the observed sizeWei of 1000000000000000, the packet reports 0 positive-gross quotes out of 2,148. For example, at block 94696456 the highest shown output is 999807508124178 wei, below the 1000000000000000 wei input; at block 94901885, quote outputs are also below input. These are quote estimates, not fills.

Known-gas accounting does not reveal an opportunity: the packet reports 0 positive-after-known-gas quotes. GasUnits already includes frozen reader overhead, but extra gas and infrastructure costs are unknown for all 179 observations; LLM costs are also unknown. Therefore neither gross output nor modelled known gas establishes cost-adjusted profit.

There were no actual fills: both baseline and candidate report 0 trades, and paperNetWei is null. The research gate is HOLD. The 43,246-second, 179-observation history is below the acceptance requirements of 604,800 seconds and 1,000 observations; the packet also flags SOURCE_GAP. Snapshot matching establishes provider consistency, not signed consensus or execution.

analysis.nextTest: Keep the frozen mevy-control-v1 unchanged and do not promote the candidate. Reassess only with fresh observations after block 94901885, retaining the original acceptance rules and requiring reconciled extra-gas, infrastructure, and LLM costs; a successor must independently meet the duration, observation-count, gap, and improvement gates.
limitations: Quotes are estimates and do not simulate executed fills, reverts, competition, private orderflow, or MEV leakage.
The packet only supports conclusions at the observed 0.001 WETH size; it provides no basis to extrapolate results to another size.
Unknown costs and the source-gap flag prevent a complete cost-adjusted performance assessment.
Passing a research gate would not itself authorize trading.

boundary: Unapproved research draft. No database proposal approval, strategy change, successor freeze, signing or trading.
